translations.web: As you sent me into the world, even so I have sent them into the world.
translations.bsb: As You sent Me into the world, I have also sent them into the world.
translations.kjv: As thou hast sent me into the world, even so have I also sent them into the world.
translations.asv: As thou didst send me into the world, even so sent I them into the world.
